cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. The police said in August 2024 the pre-war registry system was recovered and running, but the 2026 sources show electronic birth certificates resuming office by office.
cells.note: The registry's recovery (2024) restores pre-war data, while the newest facts (2026) show digital birth registration restarting in one locality and two hospitals; the newest stand, so stage 2. Question 2 needs its own evidence, so the death module does not lift it.
